name: com.yourname.ai-driven-npcs
description: Modular, prefab-based local AI NPC system. Integrates LLM (LLMUnity), speech recognition (Whisper) and TTS (PiperTTS). Drag and drop [AI System] + [NPC] prefabs into your scene. No cross-Inspector wiring needed.

samples.description: Modular AI-NPC system. Includes: AISystemManager (singleton coordinator), ChatUIController (pure UI), VoiceInputService (Whisper STT), VoiceOutputService (PiperTTS), ModelBootstrapper (model warmup), NPCAgent (per-NPC component), and ReadyScene (pre-configured demo scene).
